content:
Lean was awarded the 2025 Programming Languages Software Award at PLDI yesterday. At the Lean FRO we're thrilled about this recognition, but we're even more grateful to this community for all the energy and belief you've put into Lean over the years.

As Soonho Kong said on accepting the award: "This award goes to the actual Lean community and all the people who love Lean and using Lean." :thank_you:
